summary_zh.motivation: 为降低燃煤锅炉NOx排放并提升燃烧效率，需要准确的NOx在线测量与优化控制。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate online NOx measurement and combustion tuning are needed to reduce emissions and improve efficiency in coal-fired boilers.
summary_en.method: An attention-enhanced graph convolutional network is coupled with a hybrid whale optimization algorithm to build a NOx soft sensor and optimize combustion parameters.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach reportedly improves NOx prediction accuracy and combustion optimization performance over comparison methods.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on simulation cases using boiler operating data.
